item.title: Welcoming a new classmate
item.context_text: A new student, Lena, joins your English course in Tashkent. She is from Germany. The teacher adds her to the class group chat.
item.objective_text: Read about Lena, understand her message, write a welcome, and introduce yourself in class.
item.target_grammar: present simple: be, like, live (I live in… I like…)
item.cultural_note: When you meet someone new in English, it is normal to say your name, where you are from and one thing you like.
success_conditions: Understand the key facts about Lena
Write a friendly welcome and answer her question
Say your name, where you are from and one thing you like

children.title: Read about Lena
children.instructions: Read the teacher's message in the group chat. Then answer the questions.
children.prompt_text:
New student!
Name: Lena
From: Hamburg, Germany
Age: 19
She likes: music, football and cooking.
She is in Tashkent for six months. She speaks German and English. She wants to learn Uzbek.

questions.prompt: What does Lena want to learn?
How long is she in Tashkent?
questions.explanation: "She is in Tashkent for six months."

children.title: Listen to Lena
children.instructions: Lena sends a voice message to the group. Listen. Then answer the question. You can listen again.
children.prompt_text: Hi everyone, I'm Lena. Thank you for adding me to the group! I don't know the city yet. Is there a good place for plov near the school? Please write to me!

questions.explanation: Lena asks "Is there a good place for plov near the school?"

children.title: Write a welcome
children.instructions: Write to Lena in the group chat. Say welcome, say your name and one thing you like, and answer her question.
children.prompt_text: Lena: Hi, I'm Lena! Is there a good place for plov near the school?
children.goal: Welcome Lena, introduce yourself and answer her question.
children.model_answer: Hi Lena, welcome to our class! My name is Aziz. I like football too. Yes, there is a very good plov café on our street. Let's go on Friday!

children.title: Introduce yourself in class
children.instructions: In the next lesson, the teacher asks you to say hello to Lena. Say your name, where you are from and one thing you like.
children.prompt_text: Teacher: Please say hello to Lena and tell her about you.
children.goal: Introduce yourself: name, home town and one thing you like.
children.model_answer: Hello Lena! My name is Dilnoza. I am from Samarkand, but I live in Tashkent now. I like music and cooking.
